extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism ontology repair from primary paper and supplementary locators. mechanism_claims.claim_text: LL-37_Renalexin has source-supported broad antibacterial phenotype against S. aureus, E. coli, MRSA, and K. pneumoniae clinical isolates with Table 1 MIC values and dose-response CFU reductions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LL-37_Renalexin tag-free hybrid peptide against four bacterial clinical isolate groups
mechanism_claims.limitations: Antibacterial activity is not a direct molecular mechanism assay; final ontology does not infer a specific membrane pore or intracellular target from MIC/CFU data alone.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill experiments support killing kinetics against S. aureus and E. coli over a 3 h treatment window at approximately 2x MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LL-37_Renalexin against S. aureus and E. coli
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill and ANOVA results support antibacterial effect timing, not a direct target-binding or membrane-integrity mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hybrid design and in silico structure/toxicity analyses provide supporting context for peptide engineering and safety, but remain computational/design evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LL-37_Renalexin design, sequence, modeled structure, and in silico toxicity
